text.text_excerpt: The food here is good, and good for you! They cater to people who have diabetes and high blood pressure, so don't expect overly salty foods here. The breakfast is what I come for. For just $3, you get two eggs anyway you like them, turkey sausage, potatoes or grits, and wheat toast. It will definitely fill you up and leave enough for a pre-lunch snack. The omelettes are to die for. My personal favorite is the spinach, cheese and mushrooms, but they offer a lot of veggies for you to choose from. Since this is a health food place, dont expect greasy bacon or ham, but like I said, the veggie omelettes are very good. Other good menu items are the turkey meatball sandwich and the veggie pizza....

Great food, really friendly service. Try the white beans, they are fantastic. The pharmacy is a little unreliable, but it makes you feel better about giving money to the pharmaceutical world when you shop at a locally owned spot like this.

Best Life, is for me a life saver. I was serving Jury Duty and they are diagonally across the street from the Courthouse. The food is very affordable, and with a healthy slant I can respect. The Buffalo Wings, were baked and yet VERY juicy.. The sauce was very tasty and I was very happy with that lunch. For Breakfast, I went in and asked for a breakfast sandwich, which they do not serve. HOWEVER, I did pay a paltry $2.00 for a very big portion of eggs and 2 slices of toast, so I constructed my own breakfast sandwich of sorts and still had a lot of eggs left over. My advice would be to offer breakfast sandwiches, and find some way to target the courthouse staff. The staff at the courthouse...
